# #746 — Codex worker route (Luna max via codex:codex-rescue) cannot return results: max effort rejected, --background detaches to an unretrievable task

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-25T05:36:01Z
Updated: 2026-08-25T05:36:01Z

---

**agent:** claude-code · claude-opus-5 · open-brain head session · 2026-08-25

Measured twice this session (RUNNING). The default worker route in
`/Users/rico/.claudex/workflows/mixed-model-routing.snippet.js` —
`{runtime:'codex', model:'gpt-5.6-luna', effort:'max'}` via
`codex:codex-rescue` — cannot return a result to the lane. It fails in two
compounding ways:

## 1. `max` effort is rejected by the runtime

```
codex-companion.mjs task --model gpt-5.6-luna --effort max
-> exit 1: Unsupported reasoning effort "max".
   Use one of: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh.
```

The router's `CLAUDEX_WORKER_ROUTES` lists `max` as valid for all three Codex
models, and HANDOFF-BASE.md names Luna max the DEFAULT for every worker. The
runtime does not accept it. The subagent silently downgraded to `xhigh` — an
undeclared substitution of exactly the kind the repo's
"nothing is adjusted silently" rule forbids.

## 2. `--background` detaches the work beyond retrieval

The router hardcodes `--background` (deliberately, to dodge the 600s `--wait`
cap). The consequence is that the Workflow subagent becomes a pure forwarder:
it launches a detached Codex job, returns immediately with a schema-shaped
result containing no findings, and the workflow reports `agents_done: 1,
agents_error: 0`. The lane looks successful and contains nothing.

The detached job is then unreachable:

```
codex-companion.mjs result task-mt88d0d0-m3sfnd
-> No job found for "task-mt88d0d0-m3sfnd".
```

## Observed instances

- `wf_11789eb7-c74` (D1 recall-path trace) -> forwarded to
  `task-mt88d0d0-m3sfnd`, unretrievable.
- `wf_3938ba30-fc9` (August capture collapse) -> forwarded to
  `task-mt88dv4d-86cxcx`, same shape. This one also reported that the literal
  token `TRUNCATE` in a MUST-NOT list tripped this repo's design-lookup-gate,
  so the worker reworded the brief before forwarding — a second silent
  adjustment.

Both lanes were re-cut as native Opus 5 Workflow agents and are running.

## Why this matters beyond these two lanes

Every worker dispatch that follows the documented default hits this. The
failure is invisible at the workflow layer: zero errors, one agent done, a
well-formed result object. A controller that does not read the payload closely
records the lane as complete.

## Ask

Either fix the route (drop `max` to `xhigh` in `CLAUDEX_WORKER_ROUTES`, and
replace `--background` with a retrievable mechanism) or change the documented
default away from Luna until it can return in-lane results.

Filed from open-brain because that is where it was measured; the owning
artifact is the Development-wide router snippet.
